text.intro: Type a game seed (the value an override gives) and see the seeds that follow from it: the act seeds, one level's seed and that level's room seeds. The seed offered first is illustrative.
text.seedLabel: Game seed N (an input of our own, 1 to 2147483647)
text.actLabel: Act shown (0 is the first act)
text.levelLabel: Level id (a number of your own, added to the act's base)
text.roomsLabel: Rooms of that level to show
text.gameHow: Init(N), no draw; it seeds the units, not the map
text.actHow: Init(N), then one Step: the low word is the level seed base
text.tombsHow: Then pairs of draws mod 7 until the two differ; tombs
text.gateHow: Then one draw; the lowest bit is
text.levelHow: Init(base + level id), a sum that wraps, no draw
text.roomDrawHow: Step the level seed once; the low word is
text.roomHow: Init(that low word), then one Step
text.note: Computed by our model of the seed tree, not observed in the game. The act link builder's later draws on the act seed, room activation and the units are not shown.
